note: Keys whose value in a catalogue under src/i18n is still the English text because nobody has translated it yet. They are listed so the next translation pass finds them; a seeded value would otherwise look translated. check-untranslated.mjs holds this file and the catalogues together: once a key is translated its entry has to go (prune-untranslated.mjs takes it out), or the check fails. Unlike the web UI's check, this one also fails on a short value that equals the English one and is listed nowhere, so a key copied into the catalogues in English fails until seed-untranslated.mjs lists it here. de.ts is never listed. It is written by hand, and a German value that equals the English one (Downloads, Premium, Online) is the same word in both languages.
identicalNote: Keys whose value in a catalogue is the English one because English is right in that language, checked one language at a time: brand names (PayPal, GitHub), values without words (https://…), and words the language shares with English or took over unchanged (Premium, Server, Online, Version, Storm, Accent). They are kept apart from "locales" because the two lists mean opposite things. A key listed there is waiting for a translation; a key listed here has had one, and the answer was to keep the English. check-untranslated.mjs holds both lists against the catalogues. If an entry here stops being identical, somebody chose a word of their own, and the entry has to go.
